description: Discover metrics for one asset (BTC by default) by existing category, including honest held and delayed states. Cursor pages follow the current catalogue and are not an immutable snapshot. Use it to browse by category before an asset is chosen: without one it lists BTC, and its rows are the same as get_asset_metrics gives. Each row has the plan its data needs; fetch_metric serves rows whose plan is free.

asset.description: Asset code, for example BTC or ETH; get_assets_list gives every code with its name.

category.description: A metric family, for example market, supply or mining; the categories field of each answer lists them with their counts. Leave it out for every family.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; leave it out for the first page.

name: get_metrics_list
title: Get metrics list
